items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Run into a band like Hawkins, Erskine Hawkins and all of them.

ctx.x: So the Sweethearts was in the Philippines a long time, the other band was in Canada. Then we got involved into the way. The Treasury Department (unintelligible). Because I had to ________ every six months for (unintelligible). And I was signed up as a bar driver for the Treasury Department for these girls. One day a week for (unintelligible). Then seventh day for ourselves on their gas and their food and their cash.

And I used to let a lot of the bands use our sleeper bus. Run into a band like Hawkins, Erskine Hawkins and all of them. They wouldn't have nowhere to sleep during the way. I'd be coming through and while we was playing, I'd say, well, man, use our sleeping bus. Facilities on that and everything. Big trailer bus.
Well, what was this thing then -- it says, '47, toured with the Cavalcade of Jazz. That was Irving Muller's thing, wasn't it?
